notes: DSH APIs are prerelease; versions outside the tested range require a fresh startup and tool-call verification.
The official DSH Browser Use Playwright provider must be mounted in visible launch mode for login, CAPTCHA, and 2FA handoff.
Tencent BrowserSkill is no longer required or used by this plugin.
DSH Computer Use may remain enabled for other desktop tasks, but this plugin uses Browser Use for ChatGPT web automation.
